answer: Each identity posts a 65-credit harbor bond for one ticket to one lotus site. The harbor board issues it as a jade receipt binding key, lotus task, and auditor, so transfer breaks its seal. First: 25; the kth costs 25+6(k-1), so the 1000th fake pays 6019. For 1000 fakes, fees total 3,022,000 plus 65,000 locked; an honest agent pays 25 once and recovers 65 after work. The lotus auditor checks arrival against the receipt; mismatch burns the bond, and a rented-ticket ring fails because a reused jade receipt keeps the key without the renter's lotus signature, so both bonds burn.
